sloka: रोषितः शरवर्षेण सालेन महता महान् ।प्रजघान हयान्नीलः प्रहस्तस्य मनोजवान् ।। ६.५८.४३ ।।।।
transliteration: roṣitaḥ śaravarṣeṇa sālena mahatā mahān ।prajaghāna hayānnīlaḥ prahastasya manojavān ।। 6.58.43 ।।।।

translations.english: Just as a mighty bull faces sudden downpour of autumnal rain, in the same way Nila precisely tolerated the rain of arrows of Prahastha, which are difficult to face, with eyes closed.
